Different users have access to different functions of the site. While anyone can do most things on the site, including reading and editing, bureaucrats, administrators and moderators can access some additional functions (see Help:User rights).

All staff members and editors of the Hay Day Wiki are volunteers who do this in their free time for free.

Users with special abilities

  • User:Gizmospike - Bureaucrat/Admin
  • User:Hunngryhippo - Bureaucrat/Admin
  • User:Alpha1243 - Moderator/Admin
  • User:Xtalline - Moderator

What do special users do?

Special users are experienced editors who keep the wiki organized and easily manageable, and devoid of spam, offensive content, etc. They also find ways to settle disputes amicably whenever possible.

Contact

You can contact bureaucrats, administrators and moderators through their talk pages. For questions, suggestions and advice about the Wiki you can use Discussions or our Discord.

Legacy

Many thanks to the former users who administered this wiki for a long time and turned it into a fantastic resource, and for all their hard work and innovative ideas.

  • Ironwestie
  • Lamiah2o
  • Melicent
